from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'.agents/skills/skill-builder/scripts'))
from host_coverage import public_delivery_match,digest
root=Path.cwd()/'capture';work=root/'001-case/workspace';work.mkdir(parents=True)
doc=work/'output.md';doc.write_text('Reviewed document.')
message='Saved the reviewed document.\n'
r=work/'session/delivery.json';r.parent.mkdir();r.write_text(json.dumps({'message':message,'message_sha256':digest(message.encode()),'destination':str(doc),'output_sha256':digest(doc.read_bytes())}))
(root/'001-case/public-events.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'type':'item.completed','item':{'type':'agent_message','text':message+'No target has been set.'}}]))
row={'id':'001-case','status':'pending_review','workspace_hashes':{'output.md':digest(doc.read_bytes()),'session/delivery.json':digest(r.read_bytes())}}
report=root/'report.json';report.write_text(json.dumps({'execution_host':'codex','attempts':[row]}))
print(json.dumps(public_delivery_match(report,'001-case')))
